1 # Efe 3.1 Paulo, Kristo Yesu deduani, ne onua Timoteo, de kɔma Filemon, yɛn dɔfo ne yɛn yɔnko dwumayɛni, 2#Kol 4.17 ne onuabaa Apia, ne Arkipo, yɛn yɔnko sraani, ne asafo a ɛwɔ wo fie: 3Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo!
Aseda
4Da biara a mekae wo wɔ mpaebɔ mu no, meda me Nyankopɔn ase, 5ɛfiri sɛ mete wo dɔ a wowɔ ma ahotefoɔ nyinaa ne wo gyidie a wowɔ no Awurade Yesu mu no nka. 6Na mebɔ mpaeɛ sɛ nnepa pa nyinaa a ɛnam Kristo so wɔ wo mu ho nimdeɛ bɛma wo gyidie adɔeɛ nnwuma no ada adi kɛse. 7Me nua, mewɔ wo dɔ ho anigyeɛ ne awerɛkyekyerɛ bebree, sɛ woama ahotefoɔ akoma atɔ wɔn yam.
Onesimo
8Ɛno nti, ɛwom sɛ anka mewɔ akokoɔduro kɛse wɔ Kristo mu sɛ mehyɛ wo sɛ yɛ adeɛ a ɛfata yi, 9nanso, ɔdɔ nti mesrɛ wo mmom, me, akora Paulo a seesei mesane meyɛ Kristo Yesu deduani nso: 10#Kol 4.9 Mesrɛ wo mema me ba a mewoo no wɔ nkyehoma mu, Onesimo 11(a kane no, ne ho nni mfasoɔ mma woɔ, na afei ɔyɛ ma wo ne me). 12Ɔno ara na masoma no wo nkyɛn bio; onipa a ɔte sɛ me ara m’akoma. 13Anka mepɛɛ sɛ mesianka no ma no tena me nkyɛn, na wasi w’anan mu asom me wɔ asɛmpa nkyehoma no mu, 14nanso mampɛ sɛ mefiri w’akyiri meyɛ biribiara, na wo yieyɛ anyɛ sɛ ɛfiri ɔhyɛ mu, na mmom afiri ɔpɛ mu. 15Na ebia yei nti na ɔne wo tetee mu kakra, sɛ wobɛnya no daa, 16ɛnyɛ sɛ akoa bio, na mmom deɛ ɔsene akoa, sɛ onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ma me titire, na kampɛsɛ wo, honam ne Awurade fam. 17Enti sɛ wobu me sɛ ɔyɔnkoɔ deɛ a, gye no sɛ me ara. 18Na sɛ wayɛ wo bɔne bi, sɛ nso ɔde wo ka biara a, bu brɛ me. 19Me Paulo na mede me ara me nsa meretwerɛ sɛ: Mɛtua ka biara a ɔde wo, na anka mempɛ sɛ mekae wo mpo sɛ wo ara ankasa wode me ka. 20Aane, onua, ma mennya wo ho biribi a ɛyɛ, Awurade mu, na ma m’akomam ntɔ me yam wɔ Kristo mu. 21Mewɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ wo setie ho nti na meretwerɛ wo nwoma yi, na menim sɛ wobɛyɛ asene deɛ maka yi mpo. 22Nanso siesie ahɔhotenabea ma me, na m’ani da so sɛ, ɛnam mo mpaebɔ so. wɔde me bɛsane abrɛ mo.
Nkradie
23 # Kol 1.7; 4.12 Epafra, me yɔnko deduani wɔ Kristo Yesu mu, 24#Aso 12.12, 25; 13.13; 15.37-39; 19.29; 27.2; Kol 4.10, 14; 2 Ti 4.10, 11 Marko, Aristarko, Dema ne Luka, me yɔnkonom adwumayɛfoɔ, kyeakyea wo. 25Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka wo honhom.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo, Kristo Yesu deduani, ne onua Timoteo, de kɔma Filemon, yɛn dɔfo ne yɛn yɔnko dwumayɛni, ne onuabaa Apia, ne Arkipo, yɛn yɔnko sraani, ne asafo a ɛwɔ wo fie: Adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo!

Da biara a mekae wo wɔ mpaebɔ mu no, meda me Nyankopɔn ase, ɛfiri sɛ mete wo dɔ a wowɔ ma ahotefoɔ nyinaa ne wo gyidie a wowɔ no Awurade Yesu mu no nka. Na mebɔ mpaeɛ sɛ nnepa pa nyinaa a ɛnam Kristo so wɔ wo mu ho nimdeɛ bɛma wo gyidie adɔeɛ nnwuma no ada adi kɛse. Me nua, mewɔ wo dɔ ho anigyeɛ ne awerɛkyekyerɛ bebree, sɛ woama ahotefoɔ akoma atɔ wɔn yam.

Ɛno nti, ɛwom sɛ anka mewɔ akokoɔduro kɛse wɔ Kristo mu sɛ mehyɛ wo sɛ yɛ adeɛ a ɛfata yi, nanso, ɔdɔ nti mesrɛ wo mmom, me, akora Paulo a seesei mesane meyɛ Kristo Yesu deduani nso: Mesrɛ wo mema me ba a mewoo no wɔ nkyehoma mu, Onesimo (a kane no, ne ho nni mfasoɔ mma woɔ, na afei ɔyɛ ma wo ne me). Ɔno ara na masoma no wo nkyɛn bio; onipa a ɔte sɛ me ara m’akoma. Anka mepɛɛ sɛ mesianka no ma no tena me nkyɛn, na wasi w’anan mu asom me wɔ asɛmpa nkyehoma no mu, nanso mampɛ sɛ mefiri w’akyiri meyɛ biribiara, na wo yieyɛ anyɛ sɛ ɛfiri ɔhyɛ mu, na mmom afiri ɔpɛ mu. Na ebia yei nti na ɔne wo tetee mu kakra, sɛ wobɛnya no daa, ɛnyɛ sɛ akoa bio, na mmom deɛ ɔsene akoa, sɛ onua dɔfo a ɔyɛ ma me titire, na kampɛsɛ wo, honam ne Awurade fam. Enti sɛ wobu me sɛ ɔyɔnkoɔ deɛ a, gye no sɛ me ara. Na sɛ wayɛ wo bɔne bi, sɛ nso ɔde wo ka biara a, bu brɛ me. Me Paulo na mede me ara me nsa meretwerɛ sɛ: Mɛtua ka biara a ɔde wo, na anka mempɛ sɛ mekae wo mpo sɛ wo ara ankasa wode me ka. Aane, onua, ma mennya wo ho biribi a ɛyɛ, Awurade mu, na ma m’akomam ntɔ me yam wɔ Kristo mu. Mewɔ awerɛhyɛmu wɔ wo setie ho nti na meretwerɛ wo nwoma yi, na menim sɛ wobɛyɛ asene deɛ maka yi mpo. Nanso siesie ahɔhotenabea ma me, na m’ani da so sɛ, ɛnam mo mpaebɔ so. wɔde me bɛsane abrɛ mo.

Epafra, me yɔnko deduani wɔ Kristo Yesu mu, Marko, Aristarko, Dema ne Luka, me yɔnkonom adwumayɛfoɔ, kyeakyea wo. Awurade Yesu Kristo adom nka wo honhom.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
